title: MacOS Portfolio
Description: An interactive macOS-inspired portfolio built with React, featuring draggable and resizable windows, a dock, and a desktop interface.

title: Personal Expense Tracker
Description: A personal finance application to manage budgets, add expenses, and calculate the remaining balance using React state management.

title: Product Store
Description: A product browsing application with API data fetching, product cards, and detailed product pages using React Router and Context API.

title: DOM Mini Projects
Description: A collection of JavaScript projects designed to practice DOM manipulation, event handling, and frontend logic.

title: GitHub User Search
Description: A React application that fetches GitHub user information using an API and displays profiles, followers, following, and public repositories.
